description:
WHAT: Marine Forces Special Operations Command (MARFORSOC) Industry Day
WHERE: Hampton Inn, 1248 NC Hwy 210, Sneads Ferry, NC 28460
WHEN: Thursday, March 19, 2026

PURPOSE:
To provide information on upcoming MARFORSOC contracting opportunities.

EVENT ATTENDANCE:

  • All vendor companies must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM).
  • Attendance is on a first-come, first-served basis, and registration will close once capacity is reached.
  • There is no cost to attend, but pre-registration is mandatory. Companies may bring up to two representatives.
  • Walk-ins without pre-registration will not be allowed entry.

SESSION DETAILS:

  • Two sessions are available to accommodate more attendees:
    • Morning Session: 0830–1130
    • Afternoon Session: 1230–1530
  • Both sessions will cover the same content, and attendees may register for only one session.
  • Participants must indicate their preferred session when registering.

HOW TO REGISTER:

  • To register, visit the Eventbrite link below and complete your registration by selecting the “Registration” button.
  • Registration closes on March 18, 2026.
  • Eventbrite is the only accepted method of registration—no phone calls, please.
  • Only 1 ticket is allowed per Company. Each ticket allows up to two individuals to attend. 

Registration Links:

  • Morning Session: https://www.eventbrite.com/e/marforsoc-industry-day-morning-session-tickets-1984636058877?aff=oddtdtcreator 

  • Afternoon Session: https://www.eventbrite.com/e/marforsoc-industry-day-afternoon-session-tickets-1984637777016?aff=oddtdtcreator
